metrics.label: Acquirer premium over pre-deal valuation
metrics.definition: Deal value divided by the sourced pre-deal valuation.

estimate.selectionCaveat: Disclosed-price deals are a non-random subsample (100% of n=47 sector deals). Selection bias may inflate medians; Heckman correction not applied. 46 of 49 cited pre-deal marks are year-precision as-of dates.

metrics.label: Acquirer premium over last-known valuation
metrics.definition: Deal value divided by the target's last-known valuation.

estimate.selectionCaveat: Disclosed-price deals are a non-random subsample (100% of n=48 sector deals). Selection bias may inflate medians; Heckman correction not applied.

metrics.label: Acquirer premium over total funding
metrics.definition: Deal value divided by the target's total capital raised.

estimate.selectionCaveat: Disclosed-price deals are a non-random subsample (100% of n=7 sector deals). Selection bias may inflate medians; Heckman correction not applied.
